facts.fact: KBC reports the National Cybersecurity Agency was established through the National Cybersecurity Agency Order 2026 under the State Corporations Act, and its Board chair was appointed effective 2026-08-21.
KBC, citing the Communications Authority, reports the National KE-CIRT/CC issued advisories in January to March 2026.
The Communications Authority data cited by KBC states the National KE-CIRT/CC issued 20.6 million advisories between January and March 2026, against 21.8 million in the preceding quarter.
